title: FLASHIda enables intelligent data acquisition for top-down proteomics to boost proteoform identification counts
summary: In E. coli lysate, FLASHIda increased unique proteoform identifications from 800 to 1,500 or achieved a near-identical count in one-third the instrument time versus standard data-dependent acquisition. The result is an instrument-specific proteomics analysis; broader biological or clinical consequences are not established.
